capabilities: Sync Mendeley references into one note per document via incremental or full resync
Generate citekeys from Mendeley citation keys or author-year-title with disambiguation
Write reference metadata (title, authors, year, DOI, abstract, tags, folders) to frontmatter
Mirror the Mendeley folder hierarchy into subfolders in the vault
Preserve user-written content outside a delimited generated block on every sync
extras: Each user must register their own Mendeley application to get Client ID/Secret; tokens and secret are stored unencrypted in data.json, so users sharing or syncing their vault should exclude that file. Phase 2 (citation insertion, PDF annotation import) and Phase 3 features are not yet implemented. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull bibliographic metadata and citekeys from a Mendeley library into vault notes.

relations.evidence: syncs your Mendeley library into reading notes in your vault, using the official Mendeley API

requires.name: User-created Mendeley application Client ID and Client Secret from dev.mendeley.com

summary: Mendeley integration that syncs a Mendeley reference library into one reading note per reference, with frontmatter metadata and generated citekeys.
